alt: A ribbon path worn smooth across a faceted paper meadow.
prompt: Editorial illustration of a calm meadow at daybreak, seen from slightly above. The meadow is built from thousands of small flat faceted paper blades of grass in pale blue-grey and soft Daylight white. Across it runs one path, worn smooth by being walked again and again, the same way every day: the path is a smooth satin ribbon in a gradient from Alliance Blue at the lower left to Ribbon Cyan at the upper right, pressed a little into the grass and easy to spot from above. It stands for the task a team repeats every week, plain to see once you look for it. A few faceted paper wildflowers in Partner Navy and Alliance Blue grow beside the path. Keep the path in the middle band of the frame and the top quarter a calm, pale sky. Landscape 16:9, safe to crop to 16:10 and 4:3 around the centre. Palette only: Partner Navy #121B2A, Alliance Blue #1B56FF, Ribbon Cyan #00D5FF, Daylight #F4F7FB and the shades between them. Nature built from satin ribbon and flat paper facets. Light from the upper left, soft navy-tinted shadows falling down and to the right. No text or letters, no people, no hands, no robots, no brains, no circuit boards, no sparkles, no glow, no purple or pink, no regional or cultural motifs, no real places or landmarks.
